title: Changes in European Solidarity Before and During COVID-19: Evidence from a Large Crowd- and Expert-Annotated Twitter Dataset
reasoning: The paper's primary task is to classify text based on the expression of 'social solidarity,' which is explicitly defined as a 'moral and normative bond' within society. The classification distinguishes between pro-solidarity (a moral stance of willingness to help others) and anti-solidarity (contesting this moral stance). Therefore, the paper's core methodology is centered on evaluating expressions of a moral and ethical concept.
